description: This file implements a configuration class for integrating Vertex AI DeepSeek OCR within a larger OCR transformation framework. It handles environment validation, URL construction, request transformation (both sync and async), and response parsing to convert between OCR result formats and Vertex AI's chat completion API format.

classes.name: VertexAIDeepSeekOCRConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI DeepSeek OCR integration, providing methods for environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the full endpoint URL for Vertex AI DeepSeek OCR based on project, location, and optional API base.

methods.name: OCRRequestData transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms input OCR document into Vertex AI chat completion request format, supporting image and document URLs.

methods.name: OCRRequestData async_transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronous version of request transformation; calls the sync method.

methods.description: Parses the chat completion API response to extract OCR results, converting them into a structured OCRResponse.

methods.description: Asynchronous version of response transformation; calls the sync method.
